thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: geo-dns-monitor reports elevated SERVFAIL/SERVERRs from multiple EU resolvers (Cloudflare + Route53) starting ~2948001200. Paging oncall-ryan.

oncall-ryan: acked. joining. first pass — scope and customer impact?

meera: quick metrics: 12% of eu-edge egress requests have DNS timeouts, retry storms pushing tail latency to 900-2k ms for v1/generate and embeddings. Error spikes started ~+5m.

netops-sam: running probes from eu-pop1 and eu-pop3. seeing intermittent SOA mismatch across CF POPs and ~30% UDP timeouts to cloudflare-authoritative from our resolvers. Route53 also showing elevated NXTTL lookups.

netops-sam: (snippet)
```bash
# probe from eu-pop1
dig +time=2 @1.1.1.1 model-api.eu.redwood.ai A +short || echo "timeout"
# result: timeout / sometimes returns old A set / sometimes SERVFAIL
```

oncall-ryan: ok, immediate mitigations? can we switch geodns weights + use fallback resolvers to reduce user impact?

product-jen: recommend roll traffic to us-west as a short-term route for EU read traffic. We should keep write/latency-sensitive endpoints on dedicated routes if possible. Also let support notify top customers.

devops-ada: I can update GeoDNS config and add resolver fallback. Proposed plan: 1) lower DNS TTLs to 30s for impacted records, 2) adjust GeoDNS weight: eu -> 20%, us-west -> 80%, 3) add fallback resolvers 8.8.8.8 + 9.9.9.9 to our eu egress resolver list.

meera: lowering TTL will increase churn but lets us shift quickly. +1 on fallback resolvers.

netops-sam: opening tickets with providers: Cloudflare ticket CF-89431 "Intermittent authoritative response divergence eu-west". Route53 ticket AWS-RT-57219 "Elevated NX/TLS resolver errors". Linking logs.

support-liz: support roundup: 3 enterprise customers above threshold: AcmeCorp (2.3% errors), PillarPay (1.1%), Shoply (1.0%). I'll send proactive notes once we have mitigation steps and ETA.

devops-ada: executing step 2 now. CMD: `./geodnsctl set-weight --region eu 20 --region us-west 80 --comment "CF/Route53 instability"`

incident-bot: action logged: geodns.change by devops-ada @ 2948001540.

devops-ada: adding fallback resolvers to eu-resolver group: `ansible-playbook playbooks/egress_resolvers.yml -e resolvers=[8.8.8.8,9.9.9.9]`

netops-sam: running validation probes after changes...

netops-sam: probe results: eu-pop1 latency down to 120-220ms tail, DNS timeout rate down to 2-3%. US-west path shows slight increase but within SLO.

meera: metrics confirm application error rate back to baseline within ~3m of change. embedding request P95 down from 2.1s -> 360ms.

product-jen: nice. can we keep the GeoDNS shift for 30 minutes then gradually return if stabilizes? Need rollback plan.

devops-ada: yes. plan: keep weights for 30m, monitor 10m windows, if stable then return to normal in a controlled ramp. rollback cmd ready.

support-liz: drafting customer notification: short summary + mitigation steps + ETA for return to normal. Will post to affected accounts and status.redwood.ai.

netops-sam: update from providers: Cloudflare responded, investigating propagation / POP-soa mismatch, provided support bucket and asked for packet captures (ticket CF-89431). AWS acknowledgement pending (AWS-RT-57219).

oncall-ryan: setting Sev: SEV2 due to partial regional impact on production. Creating incident doc and linking this thread.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: ID INC-2026-0874, severity SEV2, runbook geo-dns-resolver-failover. On-call handover will be at 2948003000 to netops-sam for monitoring.

devops-ada: starting ramp-down at +30m if stable. leaving note: `./geodnsctl set-weight --region eu 65 --region us-west 35 --comment "ramp back"` as staged command.

support-liz: sent messages to AcmeCorp, PillarPay, Shoply with current status + link to incident doc.

product-jen: follow-up actions: 1) add long-term resolver health checks to our smart-routing, 2) add provider diversity to default egress for EU, 3) postmortem once incident closed.

meera: capturing evaluation prompts: regression tests for DNS fallbacks in our CI; adding to Optimize recommendations.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: mitigation reduced error rate. Monitoring for 60m.

oncall-ryan: thanks team. handing over monitoring to netops-sam for the next window. I'll update leadership after 30m. :thumbsup:

netops-sam: taking over. will close or escalate based on provider updates.
